csv_header: track_id; type; traveled_d; avg_speed; lat; lon; speed; lon_acc; lat_acc; time
selection_rule: Earliest 10-second-grid 150-second interval with at least eight valid concurrent vehicle tracks whose resampled displacement sums to at least 20m; take eight lowest original track IDs. No optimizer results were inspected for selection.
resampling: linear interpolation within original observed time interval; no extrapolation
coordinate_mapping: WGS84 latitude/longitude to spherical local tangent approximation R=6371000m about common mean coordinates; only translate scene center to (1000,1000)m, no distance/time scaling
still_simulated: UAV path and constraints, wireless channel, task data size/cycles, device compute and energy
limitations: One district/time segment; long-coverage/moving eligibility selects retained vehicles, not a random city sample
Vehicles are mobile-user proxies; no phone workload logging
Resampled points are derived, not independent GPS observations
Original synthetic safety zones are not Athens measured no-fly zones
Future ground trajectories known to offline optimizer; not prediction or live flight
